title: Published twist beta has the ambient tower and identity laws
statement: Let l be prime, S a scheme on which l is invertible, E,F,G finite extensions of Q_l, and iota:E->F and kappa:F->G coefficient embeddings. Use the completed coefficient sheaves, ordinary and completed scalar extensions [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], and signed twist W_H(-)=(-)(m) [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Write beta for the PUBLISHED integralTwistCompletedBeta [lem-weil-integral-twist-derived-scalar], a for CompletedLineTensor.associator, and v for CompletedLineTensor.unit [lem-pur-completed-line-tensor-coherence]. If C is in the full integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and hC states that W_E(C) is in that category, then, with composition read left to right, B_GF(beta_FE,C) >> beta_GF,B_FE(C) >> W_G(a_C) = a_W_E(C) >> beta_GE,C. Furthermore beta_EE,C >> W_E(v_C) = v_W_E(C), where the identity embedding is equipped with multiplication. The complete-input witnesses in a and v are the intrinsic completeness of C and of the bundled object (W_E(C),hC). The intermediate B_FE(C) is the published constructible scalar-extension object. There is no rationalization, restricted associator sfIntegralScalarComp, or common chain model in this assertion.

proof.text: The canonical first twist lines are locally free of rank one. Their scalar maps and signed powers agree with the published twistLineScalarIso by the positive tensor-power and negative evaluation normalizations. On local tensors the first-line tower follows from semilinearity and twistScalarMaps_composition; the identity map is multiplication by twistScalarMaps_identity.

proof.text: The generic ordinary signed-line comparison has exactly the sheaf tensor formula and K-flat counit normalization of integralTwistOrdinaryBeta. Local tensor generation identifies the chain maps; good-complex localization is essentially surjective, and naturality transports their equality to every integral C. Conjugating by the same specified completion maps therefore identifies the published completed beta with CompletedLineTensor.beta.

proof.text: Apply CompletedLineTensor.tower with these compatible line maps. For the identity embedding the ordinary multiplication-unit square follows on pure tensors from the identity signed-line map. Conjugate it by chi, move middle comparisons by naturality, and cancel inverse pairs, giving W(v) beta = v_W. Completeness is supplied by the integral C and hC, and by extension_complete for intermediate inputs.

theorem integral_twist_ambient_coherence (m : ℤ)
    (C : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E S)
    (hC : sfIntegralConstructible l E S
      ((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj)) :
    ((integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l F G κ S).map
        ((integralTwistCompletedBeta l E F ι S m).hom.app C) ≫
      (integralTwistCompletedBeta l F G κ S m).hom.app
        ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension (l + 1) l (ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self l))
          E F ι S).obj C) ≫
      (integralSheafTwist l G S m).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (CompletedLineTensor.associator l E S F ι G κ C.obj
          (CompletedLineTensor.intrinsic_complete l E S C)).hom =
    (CompletedLineTensor.associator l E S F ι G κ
      ((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj)
      (CompletedLineTensor.intrinsic_complete l E S
        ⟨(integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj, hC⟩)).hom ≫
      (integralTwistCompletedBeta l E G (κ.comp ι) S m).hom.app C) ∧
    ((integralTwistCompletedBeta l E E (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E) S m).hom.app C ≫
      (integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (CompletedLineTensor.unit l E S C.obj
          (CompletedLineTensor.intrinsic_complete l E S C)).hom =
    (CompletedLineTensor.unit l E S
      ((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj)
      (CompletedLineTensor.intrinsic_complete l E S
        ⟨(integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj, hC⟩)).hom)
